[ WE ARE LOOSY TALE STUDIO ]

Games that look back at you.

You think you found the page. But it found you first. Eight games so far, from jam entries you can play in a browser to a bodycam shooter in Unreal Engine 5, each built around one rule you can’t ignore.

See the games ↓ Play free on itch.io ↗
8 GAMES SHIPPED & COOKING NOW FILMING: BADGE & BLOOD ↓ [ 00 : 00 : 00 ] FOLLOW: ITCH.IO ↗ GITHUB ↗ SCROLL ↓

Hi, I’m MarySue (Viktar Syanau). I’ve been designing and programming games for 11 years, and I like to build all of it myself: the rules, the code, the trailers, and the tools when nothing else fits.

Loosy Tale Studio is my label for that work. Five of its games were made for game jams, and the best ones keep growing after the jam ends.

[ 08 ] Our games

We make short, strange games for jams and for keeps, in Unreal, Haxe, Rust, Daslang and C#, whatever the tale needs. Here’s what’s out, and what’s still cooking.

[ GAMES ][ HOVER TO PEEK · CLICK A GAME FOR ITS TRAILER ]

  1. No reticle. No HUD. Just the camera on your chest and whatever walks into the frame.

    A bodycam shooter in Unreal Engine 5: a chest-mounted fisheye, golden-hour light, glass and cardboard that break the way they should, drivable cars with a garage to tune them, and one-on-one duels over LAN.

  2. You signed a five-picture deal. The director wants every stunt for real, and there’s no stunt double.

    Wall-run, slide, flip and swing on the hook through three action movies: feudal Japan, the Wild West and a frozen city. Every stunt is also your armor. Die, and it’s CUT!: the tape rewinds and you go again.

  3. Junction 4 went silent. You’re the inspector sent down to find the crew.

    Your chest bodycam never stops recording. Hold R to replay the last 10 seconds: the tape shows what your eyes missed. The Lineman only exists on tape, and every replay drains your battery. Stay in the light.

    PLATFORM
    WINDOWS · 10–15 MIN

  4. Five couriers, one parcel, two minutes. Forty thousand light-years. Or it’s free.

    Your ship breaks every few seconds, and each fault is a microgame you have moments to fix. Every fix makes you faster, and the music speeds up with you. 14 microgames across four sectors, a Hyperlane boss, and five pilots with their own stories.

  5. Republic of Loria, 1967. You’re employee #447-B. Management has full confidence in you. Management also left early.

    Talk to clients, inspect passports and contracts, search the citizen database on a green-screen bank computer, and decide who walks out approved. Catch the fake IDs.

  6. King Edwin is dead. You killed him. Now keep the throne, one impossible choice at a time.

    You are Gregor, the usurper. Courtiers and commoners come before the throne, one a day, and every answer moves nine pillars of power: people, church, army, treasury, health, loyalty, nobility, food and succession. Survive 365 days of rule.

  7. Beneath the earth, after a sleep longer than the kingdoms of men, an eye opens.

    A hardcore turn-based isometric tactics game. Every order is yours: cover, overwatch, Steel Nerves and the Psycho Stability of your squad. The current build holds the Prologue, Act I and the Endless Stand mode.

    An isometric horde-survival slasher with character progression across five biomes: woods, swamp, frost, citadel and hell. Demo v0.5 is an alpha build with the core combat in place.

Tools from 3 a.m.

[ OPEN SOURCE ON GITHUB · 11 REPOS ]

C# · MONOGAME★ 12 MaryS Game Engine A modular 2D turn-based engine with a drag-and-drop editor and an AI assistant. RUST★ 5 SensePad Turns a DualSense controller into a drum machine: pads, a looper and DJ effects. LUA · MOD★ 5 Silent Hill 2 Co-op Mod An experimental two-player co-op mod and launcher for Silent Hill 2 (2024). Unofficial fan project. TYPESCRIPT★ 4 Maris Local AI A private AI assistant that runs entirely on your PC: chat, a coding agent, memory and local image and video generation. JAVASCRIPT★ 4 Travelling Kingdom A sidebar travel companion for VS Code and Cursor. Walk the road and recruit companions while you work. TYPESCRIPTNEW Brackets A Twitch chat bot that answers your viewers in your own manner while you play.
